2. Petitioner alleges the willful and
deliberate non-compliance of writ
court's order dated 16.06.2026
passed in WPSS No.1577 of 2026
Lakhvinder Singh Vs. State of
Uttarakhand and others and Batch of
writ petitions, whereby, petitioner
was given liberty to file
representation to respondent No.2
within two weeks from the date of
passing of the order dated
16.06.2026 and if such
representation was filed by
petitioner, respondent No.2 was
directed to consider and decide the
same within eight weeks from the
date of receipt of representation, by
passing a speaking and reasoned
order.
3. It is contended by learned
counsel for petitioner that petitioner
has submitted the representation and
the same has been decided and

UKHC010151682026

rejected by the respondent-contemnor vide order dated
18.08.2026. He produced copy of the
order dated 18.08.2026 passed by
respondent-contemnor No.1 before
this Court, which is taken on record.
4. Having perused the order dated
18.08.2026 passed by respondent-contemnor No.1, this Court is of the
view that no contempt is made out
against the respondents-contemnors.
5. Accordingly, the contempt
petition is dismissed.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
